shortDescription: The Russian government has extended a ban on diesel exports for fuel producers until the end of October, it said on Wednesday.Russia introduced restrictions on exports of gasoline, jet fuel and diesel because of domestic fuel shortages exacerbated by Ukrainian drone strikes on oil refineries.
